args.title: Tamarack Components – Freight Pricing Summary
args.body:
• Newsletter ("Freight pricing this quarter"): Covers Q outlook on freight pricing, linking to a full article on spot vs. contract rate trends.
• Article ("Freight pricing this quarter"): Spot rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady; fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel price movements instead of a fixed schedule.
• Companion piece (subscriber-only, accessed via team code SUB-8225): Shippers who split their volume across three carriers achieved the lowest overall freight costs.
